user.title: Set up Time Shifter
user.description: Create a time-shifted sensor that shows historical states. Name and entity_id are generated from the source entity and offset.

data_description.source_entity: The entity to shift in time
data_description.offset_hours: How many hours in the past to show the state (must be positive)
data_description.prefetch_interval: How often to fetch new historical data
data_description.buffer_seconds: Extra buffer to ensure smooth transitions
